verdict.rationale: Paperspace states directly that you can bring your own SSH key and connect to the VM with full root access. Its docs confirm SSH connections to Linux and Windows machines and an authentication choice at machine creation. One hands-on community report calls getting SSH access an "uphill battle"; that describes friction, not a failure of the capability, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on SSH key upload and management, documented depth of root/sudo control, and independent hands-on confirmation that bring-your-own-key root SSH works smoothly.

support.subject: As a developer, I can SSH into my GPU instance with my own keys and get root-level control of the environment
